model_audit_flags.issue: cleaning_score and hygienic_risk are derived only from residual soil; they are not microbiological measurements.
model_audit_flags.recommended_human_review: Do not treat cleaning_score as food-safety verification.
model_audit_flags.suggested_experiment: Correlate cleaning_score against ATP/microbial swabs in a future calibration campaign.

calibration_priorities: Re-estimate soil-removal kinetics (k_cal and base rates) from plant/literature data.
Re-derive the effluent COD model so it tracks organic soil load (soil0).
Separate organic vs chemical contributions to COD with measured data.
minimum_real_measurements_needed: Time-resolved effluent COD per CIP phase.
Initial soil load (soil0) proxy and post-clean residual soil / ATP.
Inlet/outlet temperatures and thermal energy for heat-recovery validation.
Water flow and recovered-water fraction per phase.
manuscript_limitations_text: [MOCK] The mechanistic twin is an uncalibrated proof of concept. Effluent COD_mgL is an ORGANIC-load proxy driven by soil removal (so it tracks soil0); NaOH residual is reported separately as NaOH_residual_mgL / COD_chem_equiv_mgL and is NOT folded into organic COD. cleaning_score is a soil-based proxy rather than a microbiological measurement. Results are simulation-generated synthetic data and require calibration with industrial measurements and food-safety validation before any operational interpretation.
data_label: simulation-generated synthetic data - NOT real industrial data
audit_note: AI-assisted model auditing only. No automatic recalibration performed; human supervision required.
